national_news.title: BRICS New Delhi Declaration Condemns Pahalgam Terror Attack and Reaffirms Zero Tolerance
bullets: BRICS leaders unanimously adopted the New Delhi Declaration on the opening day of the summit hosted under India's chairship.
The declaration explicitly condemned the Pahalgam terrorist attack in Jammu and Kashmir and reaffirmed the bloc's commitment to zero tolerance for terrorism.
Member nations called for decisive action against cross-border terror movements, terror financing, safe havens, and UN-designated terrorist entities.

national_news.title: PM Modi Holds Bilateral Talks on Sidelines of 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi
bullets: India hosted the 18th BRICS Summit at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted bilateral meetings with leaders of partner and member countries, including Kazakhstan, Egypt, South Africa, and the Philippines.
Ten official partner countries, including Malaysia, Thailand, Nigeria, and Vietnam, participated in sessions focused on inclusive global growth.

national_news.title: PM Modi Proposes BRICS Troika Mechanism and Global Governance Reforms
bullets: India's BRICS Sherpa Sudhakar Dalela briefed on key initiatives pitched by Prime Minister Modi during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
PM Modi proposed establishing a BRICS Troika mechanism to ensure continuity and smooth coordination across leadership transitions between chairs.
Proposals also included a roadmap for reforming global governance institutions, assistance for stranded seafarers, and boosting negotiating capacity for the Global South.

national_news.title: PM Modi Meets Global Leaders; UAE Announces $11.5 Billion Investment in Odisha
bullets: PM Narendra Modi held bilateral discussions with leaders of Ethiopia, Malaysia, Vietnam, and Abu Dhabi on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit 2026.
UAE's International Holding Company announced an $11.5 billion investment to establish an integrated greenfield aluminium project in Odisha.
Vietnam participated in the summit as a official Partner Country, reaffirming its strategic role as a major pillar in India's Act East Policy.

national_news.title: Second Season of Archery Premier League Scheduled in Hyderabad
bullets: The second season of the Archery Premier League (APL) will be hosted at People's Plaza in Hyderabad from October 8 to 18.
Jointly supported by the Archery Association of India and the Government of Telangana, the league features six mixed-gender franchise teams competing in Recurve and Compound categories.
The tournament incorporates a unique 15-second shot clock format, which is five seconds faster than standard Olympic timing to test speed and decision-making under pressure.

national_news.title: India's 2026 BRICS Presidency to Expand Strategic Energy and Trade Ties with Gulf
bullets: Ahead of India's 2026 BRICS Presidency, energy and investment ties with the Gulf region are expanding into clean energy, food security, and logistics.
India launched formal negotiations for a Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement with the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), covering Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.
The inclusion of Saudi Arabia and the UAE in the expanded BRICS bloc strengthens global energy dynamics and trade security along critical routes like the Strait of Hormuz.

national_news.title: SEBI Proposes New Framework for Expiry-Day Derivative Settlement Prices
bullets: Capital markets regulator SEBI issued a consultation paper proposing changes to the methodology for calculating expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives.

The proposals offer two options: a blended Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) using the last 30 minutes of the continuous trading session and the 10-minute Closing Auction Session (CAS), or continuing the existing CTS VWAP model.
The review follows industry feedback regarding the use of the CAS framework—introduced on August 3—for derivative contract settlements on expiry days.

national_news.title: RBI Reports Robust FCNR-B Inflows and Outlines Liquidity Management Strategy
bullets: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) reported robust inflows through Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR-B] schemes, reflecting strong investor confidence in India's macro fundamentals.

The RBI noted that surplus liquidity in the banking system will be managed via currency in circulation, forex interventions, and reserve requirements to align the weighted average call rate with the repo rate.
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is evaluating inflation dynamics and crude oil price movements stemming from West Asian geopolitical tensions ahead of its policy meeting.

national_news.title: Saragarhi Day Commemorates the Historic 1897 Battle of Saragarhi
bullets: Saragarhi Day was observed on September 12 to honor 21 British-Indian Sikh soldiers who made the supreme sacrifice defending Saragarhi Fort against nearly 10,000 Afghan tribesmen in 1897.
The historic battle was fought under the leadership of Havaldar Ishar Singh of the 36th Sikh Regiment in the Samana village of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (present-day Pakistan).
All 21 soldiers were posthumously awarded the Indian Order of Merit, the highest military gallantry award available to Indian soldiers at the time, which is equated to the modern Param Vir Chakra.

national_news.title: FCNR-B Inflows Reflect Strong Confidence in India's Macroeconomy: RBI
bullets: Inflows through Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) [FCNR-B] and related foreign capital schemes have remained robust, reflecting global confidence in India's macroeconomic stability.
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) confirmed it has adequate monetary tools to manage surplus liquidity and align the weighted average call rate with the repo rate.
The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is tracking West Asia crude oil price dynamics to assess their pass-through impact on domestic inflation and economic growth.

national_news.title: Mera Yuva Bharat Mobilizes Youth for Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue 2027
bullets: The 'Mera Yuva Bharat' (MY Bharat) initiative organized district-level advisory meetings to promote youth participation in the upcoming Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) 2027.
The Viksit Bharat Quiz targets youth aged 15 to 29, featuring thematic tracks such as Design for Bharat, Youth Parliament, Hack for Social Cause, and Youth Entrepreneurs Challenge.
The initiative aims to align youth innovation, leadership skills, and talent with the vision of achieving Viksit Bharat @2047.

national_news.title: National Bamboo Mission Drives Livelihoods and Enterprise Growth
bullets: The National Bamboo Mission (NBM) continues to foster sustainable livelihoods, bamboo tissue culture, processing facilities, and market linkages for farmers and micro-enterprises across India.
A key regulatory reform in 2017 amended the Indian Forest Act 1927 to exclude bamboo grown in non-forest areas from the definition of a 'tree', deregulating its harvesting and transit.
Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and local enterprises across Northeastern states and Central India are leveraging platforms like the SARAS Aajeevika Mela to scale bamboo-based enterprises.

national_news.title: India Enters Women's Asia Cup 2026 Final after Defeating Bangladesh
bullets: India defeated Bangladesh by 40 runs in the first semi-final of the Women's Asia Cup 2026 held in Dubai to secure a spot in the tournament final.
Opener Shafali Verma was named Player of the Match for her top-scoring performance of 64 runs off 40 balls, leading India to 149/6.
Spinner Deepti Sharma took 3 wickets for India, restricting Bangladesh to 109/7 in their 20 overs.

national_news.title: PIB Organizes First Media Exposure Tour from Arunachal Pradesh to Gujarat
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) concluded its first-ever exposure tour for media representatives from Arunachal Pradesh to Gujarat to foster national integration.

The delegation visited key infrastructure and developmental landmarks including Dholera Greenfield Smart City, GIFT City, Sabarmati Multimodal Transport Hub, AMUL, Sardar Sarovar Dam, and the Statue of Unity.
The program facilitated cultural exchange between North-Eastern and Western India, including interactions with the Rathwa tribal community in Ekta Nagar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Sets 75% Attendance Goal and Plans Global Exposure for College Faculty
bullets: The Bihar government has established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, especially in rural areas.
The state government announced plans to identify 100 college teachers to send abroad for one-month training courses at top international institutions.
Bihar currently allocates over 21% of its annual state budget towards the education sector, spanning primary schools to higher education institutions.

bihar_news.title: Severe Floods Affect Over 48 Lakh People Across 15 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Nearly 48.22 lakh people across 87 blocks in 15 districts of Bihar have been impacted by rising water levels in major rivers including the Ganga, Kosi, Gandak, and Bagmati.
The Disaster Management Department deployed 27 SDRF and 10 NDRF teams, operating 1,794 boats and setting up 1,248 community kitchens for flood relief.
The Water Resources Department issued bank erosion alerts as river levels recede, especially along vulnerable stretches near Sultanganj, Khagaria, and Munger.

bihar_news.title: SJVN Achieves Full Operationalization of 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: SJVN successfully achieved Commercial Operation Date (COD) for Unit-II (660 MW) of the 1320 MW (2x660 MW) Supercritical Buxar Thermal Power Project at Chausa, Bihar.
Developed at a total revised investment of ₹13,756.56 crore by SJVN Thermal Private Limited, 85% of the generated power is allocated to Bihar under a long-term PPA.
The plant is designed to generate 9,828.72 million units of electricity annually at an 85% Plant Load Factor (PLF) and marks SJVN's first fully operational thermal power project.

bihar_news.title: Monolithisch India Secures Quartzite Block in Bihar's Nawada for Rs 157 Crore
bullets: Monolithisch India secured a quartzite stone block in Bihar's Nawada district through an e-auction conducted by the state Mines and Geology Department for Rs 157 crore.
The block has been allotted for a 5-year lease with an approved annual mining capacity of 7,10,000 metric tonnes (MT), totaling 35.5 lakh MT over the lease period.
The acquisition enables raw material backward integration for producing premixed ramming mass, a crucial refractory material for induction furnaces in secondary steel plants.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Prepares for Month-Long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan'
bullets: Bihar Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired a high-level review meeting to oversee preparations for the state's 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan', scheduled from September 17 to October 17.
The campaign features 13 key components starting with 'Aashirwad ka Diya', involving lamp lighting across every household and public locations with support from Jeevika, ULBs, and PDS.

Major initiatives include school competitions under 'Seva Chitra', Anganwadi events under 'Aangan ka Milan', 'Seva Jyoti Yatra' rallies with Mera Yuva Bharat volunteers, and Chhath ghat cleaning under 'Seva Mera Yogdan'.
